feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Trump gave Xi Jinping a warm welcome. What did the talks accomplish?
entry.summary: From the National Archives to the state dinner, President Trump and Xi Jinping looked comfortable together in Washington. Two former NPR China correspondents on what the visit did and didn't deliver.

entry.title: Is Congo's Ebola outbreak coming under control?
entry.summary: Four months in, Congo's Ebola outbreak is one of the largest ever recorded. Officials and outside experts can't agree on whether it's finally slowing down.

entry.title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
entry.summary: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

entry.title: Why this island paradise has the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic
entry.summary: In mid-September, Fiji's government declared a national emergency because of a startling rise in HIV infections. The country's crystal meth epidemic is a strong contributing factor.

entry.title: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV has warned that a "paradise of machines" could undermine humanity. He raises concerns about artificial intelligence, nuclear arms, and human rights during his visit to France.

entry.title: Takeaways from the Trump-Xi state visit: Pageantry and pandas
entry.summary: The visit comes at an important time for both men.

entry.title: There's a global pandemic treaty that's signed -- and in 'limbo.' What's the holdup?
entry.summary: The treaty aims to help the countries of the world prepare for — and defeat — any future pandemic. Why hasn't it gone into effect?

entry.title: Pope Leo warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity on his France visit
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV raised existential concerns about scientific progress, life and human rights during a speech on his first papal visit to France.

entry.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit. And, Netanyahu gives defiant UNGA speech
entry.summary: Trump and Xi's U.S. summit continues after a state dinner Thursday night. And, Netanyahu returns to Israel after giving a defensive and defiant speech at the U.N. General Assembly.

entry.title: Former U.S. ambassador to China on Xi Jinping's visit to Washington
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former U.S. Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns about Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington and what has been accomplished.
